prompt:
Create a faithful generated game asset for Kipepeo, exact incarnation Resident Evil 5 (2009). Use the attached verified references only. Preserve the precise head, anatomy, proportions, costume, equipment, material colours and asymmetric details. Do not mix games, phases or editions. Preserve those structures and fine wing endpoints inside generous new padding. Airborne parasite idle with anterior mouth-end directed RIGHT, no invented feet or human limbs. The second catalogue crop is only a detail reference, not an entire body.
Composition: at least ten percent clear transparent padding around every body, wing, foot, tail and equipment endpoint. One complete boss entry in ONE image, clear rightward presentation; no animation grid, scenery, labels or added coloured halo. Preserve real anatomical asymmetries; no software mirror.
sourceObservation: Complete actual-game Kipepeo silhouette visible: four red veined wing lobes, narrow thorax, entire segmented hanging lower body, two thin curling side tendrils and distal hooked/mouth appendage are inside frame. It is flying parasite anatomy without humanoid ground feet.
